CommoditySpotOption.description:
Option on spot commodity. Options on a specified futures contract use
[`crate::commodity::commodity_future_option::CommodityFutureOption`], including futures delivery.

# Pricing

- **European options**: Black-76 model using the forward price from the `PriceCurve`
- **American options**: Binomial tree (Leisen-Reimer) with cost-of-carry derived from
  the forward/spot relationship

Analytical delta measures currency per unit change in the resolved forward,
holding discount factors and volatility fixed. At zero volatility or expiry,
the intrinsic-payoff derivative is used; delta is defined as zero exactly at
the strike, where the mathematical derivative does not exist.

# American Option Assumptions

For American exercise, the model requires a spot price to build the binomial tree.
`spot_id` must identify an observed spot for early exercise and Monte Carlo.
The commodity forward is never substituted for the spot underlying.
The convenience yield (cost-of-carry) is implied from the forward/spot ratio:
`q = r - ln(F/S)/T`

Bermudan exercise uses the configured exercise schedule and a binomial
tree. The schedule must contain at least one strictly future date when the
option is priced before expiry.

# Forward Price Retrieval

Forward prices are retrieved from a `PriceCurve` (not a `ForwardCurve`).
The curve must be added via `MarketContext::insert_price_curve()`.
If `quoted_forward` is provided, it overrides the curve lookup.

attributes.description:
Attributes for tagging and selection.
Attributes for scenario selection and tagging

day_count.description: Day count convention for time to expiry.

discount_curve_id.description: Discount curve ID for present value.

exercise.description: Recorded exercise or expiry; required after expiry while settlement remains unpaid.

exercise_dates.description:
Optional Bermudan exercise schedule.

Required when `exercise_style == ExerciseStyle::Bermudan`.

forward_curve_id.description: Forward/futures curve ID for price interpolation.

quoted_forward.description: Optional quoted forward price (overrides curve lookup).

settlement.description:
Settlement type (physical or cash).

Cash fixes the payoff on exercise; physical retains the marked delivery
claim until its recorded settlement date.

spot_id.description: Optional spot price ID (for spot-based pricing and American options).

underlying_ticker.description: Commodity symbol label (e.g., "CL", "GC", "NG"); never a market-data key.

vol_surface_id.description: Volatility surface ID for implied vol.

CommoditySpotOptionExercise.description: Recorded exercise or expiry of a spot commodity option.

date.description: Exercise date, or expiry observation date for an unexercised option.

exercised.description: True for exercise/assignment; false records expiration without exercise.

settlement_date.description: Actual cash-payment or physical-delivery date, on or after exercise.

spot.description: Positive observed commodity spot price in strike units.

ExerciseStyle.description: Exercise schedule convention for option models.

oneOf.description: Exercise at any eligible time through expiry.
Exercise on a finite schedule of eligible dates.

InstrumentSchema.description: Canonical schema marker for persisted instrument envelopes.

OptionType.description: Option payoff direction used by analytical and numerical model engines.

PositiveF64Wire.description:
Finite JSON number that is strictly greater than zero.

This type is used by serde field adapters so runtime deserialization and
generated schemas enforce the same positive-number contract.
